audit.why: Yuumi has no ranged answer to Xerath's poke while unattached, and full/content already agree Xerath wins all 7 rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit and named a fabricated ability 'E Shocking Orb'; it also failed to state that Yuumi's W (You and Me!) has zero cooldown, meaning her untargetable dash is always available rather than something to bait out.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with the real numbers and dropped the fabricated ability name.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Yuumi's Final Chapter (R) is an interruptible channel, and that You and Me! (W) can pull an ally out of the way of Xerath's own channeled ult — neither was stated.
audit.why: enemyKit.R carries the channel flag (interruptible — any CC cancels it); enemyKit.W is a dash to an ally that can reposition them out of a landed ult.

edits.before: - Yuumi You and Me! (Attach): matchup-defining — Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Shocking Orb banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Yuumi's W (You and Me!) has zero cooldown — she can dash to save her ADC any time, so untargetable is the default state, not a cooldown. - Bank your E for her all-in. - Her R (120/110/100s) only pays off if you can punish the channel.

edits.before: Q the pair from beyond answer range, W the dodge, walk — one-way ledgers per wave.
edits.after: Land Q on her the instant she detaches to auto or cast — she has zero answer at range.

edits.before: Charging Q inside hook range — the artillery that forgets geography becomes the exhibit.
edits.after: Wasting your ult on an attached carry — kill the host first or the shield eats it.

edits.before: Track Yuumi’s You and Me! (Attach): Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Yuumi's You and Me!: untargetable while attached — kill the host, not the shield. Her R is a channel your CC interrupts outright.
